notes.title: Unleash The WAAAGH!
notes.content:
[h2]It's here Boyz![/h2]

Your explosive adventure on Luteus Alpha starts NOW! Krump your way through the hive city of Luteus Prime; battle Humans, Orks and Genestealer cultists; and ultimately recover your luscious hair squig from the hands of the Warboss Gutrekka! Tackle the chaotic campaign as a lone wolf in singleplayer, or round up the Boyz for that extra dakka in some explosive multiplayer mayhem.

[b]Warhammer 40,000: Shootas, Blood & Teef[/b] is OUT NOW on PC and Switch. Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S versions will arrive October 25th, while PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5 will launch on December 2nd.

[previewyoutube=tsirLOXA-lU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]Purchase Warhammer 40,000: Shootas, Blood & Teef now and receive a 10% discount.[/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1324530/Warhammer_40000_Shootas_Blood__Teef/
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Warhammer 40,000: Shootas, Blood & Teef Features[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Classic 2D side-scrolling goodness, filled with intense action, funny one-liners, screaming deaths and comical dialogues!
[*] Choose your class, picking between four distinct characters, each with their own unique toolkit true to the Warhammer 40,000 lore.
[*] Inflict chaos with an arsenal of weapons at your fingertips. Expand your armoury with up to twenty different weapons. There’s no such thing as having too much dakka!
[*] Unleash your Waaagh! at the right time! Wreak carnage and rain destruction on those puny ‘umies.
[*] Challenge the mightiest empire in the Warhammer 40,000 universe. Become victorious, bring the planet to its knees and lead your very own Waaagh!
[*] Earn hats by destroying compelling bosses, completing milestones or exchanging Teef at the Mekboy shop. Teef are collected by tearing through the story.
[*] Beautiful hand-drawn scenery gives an incredible sense of depth to a side-on world.
[*] Break up the action, and immerse yourselves in engaging cinematics.
[*] Set foot on Luteus Prime in single-player mode, or get a party together of up to four Ork Boyz and have some fun together! Multiplayer is available both online and in local co-op.
[*] Brawl it out against your rivals in an all-out epic battle to decide who is the baddest Ork in the warband! Up to four boyz can scrap it out in the arena, both online and in local PvP.
[*] Get your socks rocked off with an amazing heavy metal soundtrack, composed by Deon van Heerden.
[*] Yes, there will be explosions. Like, a lot of them!
[/list]

Join the official Warhammer 40,000: Shootas, Blood & Teef [url=www.discord.gg/bvQgQKkNNE]Discord[/url] to recruit other Boyz to your warband, or to chat with the devs. Follow us on socials to stay up to date with the latest news.
[url=https://www.facebook.com/Rogueside]Facebook[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/RoguesideGames]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://www.instagram.com/roguesidegames/]Instagram[/url]

See you in the chaos!
Rogueside

notes.title: A new adventure set in a different universe approaches...
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

It's been a long time in the making, and we are so excited we can finally reveal our new upcoming run and gun platformer [i]Warhammer 40,000: Shootas, Blood & Teef[/i]!

Check out the awesome announcement trailer we made!

[previewyoutube=N1KSCJP7-OA;full][/previewyoutube]
Play as a savage warrior of the Green Tide, and become the spearhead of an Ork invasion as you bash, smash and shoot your way through the hive city of Luteus Prime on a mission to retrieve your hair squig and claim vengeance on your warlord! 

And just maybe become the warboss of a WAAAGH! along the way? Survival of the strongest has never been so violently fun! Scour the battlegrounds, defeat powerful bosses and collect teef to upgrade your arsenal and increase firepower!

[b]Key Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Action-Packed Gameplay:[/b] Being an Ork has never been this fun! Prepare yourself for a non-stop, action-packed platform game where you bash, smash and shoot your way through a deeply engrossing story. Not only will you take on the Astra Militarum, but also Genestealer Cults, Space Marines and of course other Orks!

[*] [b]Unique classes:[/b] Play as one of multiple classes, each with their own unique toolkit and playstyle! 

[*] [b]Wide variety of firepower:[/b] Destroy your enemies just the way you like it! Choose between a giant arsenal of different weapons spread across several categories. Do you like big explosions? Blast enemies to bits powerful with the Rokkit Launcha! Love it when your gun has a kick? Pick up the mighty Boomstikk. And remember… there’s no such thing as too much dakka!
[*] [b]WAAAGH!:[/b] As fights continue, the anger inside keeps building up, until the moment it erupts and all hell breaks loose! Explode in a storm of bullets with unlimited ammo and rain destruction on dem ‘umies!

[*] [b]Online and Local Co-op Mode:[/b] Blasting ‘umies is more fun when you do it together! Bring together four people, local or online, and fight through the hordes of guardsmen, genestealers, aberrants, intercessors, ratlings, … in this incredibly fun arcade-style co-op action mode!

[*] [b]Versus Multiplayer:[/b] Show your clan who the fiercest Ork in the Green Tide is. Battle it out against other gits, dominate in battle and show them who is the most brutal or cunning!
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1324530

Check out www.shootasbloodteef.com for more infromation and stay in the loop by signing up to our newsletter!

Join the [url=discord.gg/bvQgQKkNNE]Official Shootas, Blood & Teef Discord[/url] to learn more and chat with the development team - and be sure to follow us on social media for all the latest news and updates.
[url=https://www.facebook.com/Rogueside/]Facebook[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/RoguesideGames]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://www.instagram.com/roguesidegames/]Instagram[/url]

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
Versus mode is now available to turn friends into foes and foes into pulp! With even faster action, new areas and AI.

This AI can calculate all your moves and tricks 1 million times faster than you do and can predict the future. It's prediction: You will die.

Do you think your reflexes and years of experience can outsmart 21kb of seemingly random gibberish code? Find out soon!

Don't have anyone around? ... Neither did we! As we locked ourselves into our basements and  build a new battle AI ready to take over the world. And no better way to test it out then to put it in our new versus mode.

[img]http://info.gunsgorecannoli.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/VersusMode.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update v1.1.1
notes.content:
Hello Gangsters! 

We designed new skins inspired by feedback from the community.
Gamers can now choose between different characters to play with.

[img]https://scontent-ams3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xpf1/t31.0-8/12891132_10154129352324189_8986300613134897992_o.jpg[/img]

Our team also introduced cheat codes. They can be enabled by typing ‘cheats’ in the main menu.
A cheats buttons will become visible and allows you to activate a variety of cheats.

Turkish language is now available for the interface and cutscene subtitles.

Be sure to test out the new update and share with your friends!

Update Notes:
New / improvements
- New skins
- Fading has been added before cutscenes and level completions
- New splash screen
- Added more loading screens
- Maxim gun feels more powerful when shooting
- Rat boss feels stronger
- Dead units now stay on the floor longer and are less likely to be removed in full view

Balancing:
- Your flamethrower now does more damage. Enemy flamethrower damage has not been changed.
- Molotov now does more damage.
- Your magnum bullets now fly faster. Enemy magnum bullets are not changed.
- Rat boss has slightly more hit points. Also some smaller rats now spawn during this boss.

Fixes:
- Fixed water issue where objects would sometimes not generate splashes
- Fixed depth of units
- Fixed co-op issue where one player is able to pull his/her teammates into a pit
- When respawning in co-op you can no longer be damaged by electrical beams
- Fixed issue where burping lady gas would not spawn
- Fixed issue where burping lady would not want to jump
- Fixed issue where sometimes a sound would not play
- Fixed issue where Vinnie would visually spawn with the wrong weapon for a split second
- Fixed issue where some indestructible items would shake when being hit
- Fixed rare crash

Have fun playing!

The Crazy Monkey Studios Team

[*]Fixed issue where a weapon would incorrectly show as if it had no more ammo.
[*]Fixed rare crash that happened when leaving a level.
[*]Fixed issue where cutscenes were showing a black screen instead.
[*]Fixed issue where a friendly AI could get stuck while following you.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Inspired by feedback from reviews and from the community.
[list]
[*]Fixed issue that causes weapons to shoot one time too many when pressing the shoot button repeatedly. This was also referred to as the "sticky keys" issue.
[*]Improved subtitles sync in cutscenes.
[*]Added option in menu to put cutscenes upside down for those that do not have the correct codex installed.
[*]Fixed issue where a cutscene would still play even though Vinnie already died.
[*]Added brief moment where you can't be hit when respawning in co-op play.
[*]Added moving platform sounds.
[*]Made in game hints font more readable.
[*]Improved controller / keyboard navigation in menus
[/list]
